goal: For every open Product_Recall, report the batch, the medicine, the authorizing manager and how many days the recall has been running.

dynamic_steps.instruction: Query the Product_Recall table to identify all open recalls, including their BatchID, RecallStartDate, and any associated MedicineID or EmployeeID (authorizing manager).
dynamic_steps.observation:
```sql
SELECT
    BatchID,
    RecallStartDate,
    MedicineID,
    EmployeeID
FROM
    Product_Recall
WHERE
    RecallEndDate IS NULL;
```
